svg.title: Figure 3-3. Functional flow (WP-S-03 §3.4)
svg.desc: Processes: camerad: road and cabin camera frames; modeld: AI-1 driving model: path, lanes, leads, curvature; plannerd: longitudinal plan: leads, set speed; controlsd: control law: steering torque, acceleration; card: CAN to carState; commands to CAN frames; pandad: link to the panda: frames, mode, heartbeat; dmonitoringmodeld: AI-3 driver monitoring model; dmonitoringd: driver monitoring policy: timers, lockout; radard: lead fusion: radar and vision; selfdrived: engagement, events, alerts, warnings. Services: modelV2 modeld → plannerd; longitudinalPlan plannerd → controlsd; carControl controlsd → card; carState card → controlsd; sendcan card → pandad; can pandad → card; modelV2 modeld → controlsd; radarState radard → plannerd; driverStateV2 dmonitoringmodeld → dmonitoringd; driverMonitoringState dmonitoringd → selfdrived; selfdriveState selfdrived → controlsd; selfdriveState selfdrived → pandad; pandaStates pandad → selfdrived. Envelope: RX checks, Authority, Limits, Transmit.
svg.text: Figure 3-3 · Functional flow: from what the car sees to what it does
The functions in the order they act, by partition rather than by hardware, with where each kind of AI error enters and what the envelope can catch
QM partition · SoC processes (E-01) and models (E-02)
ASIL C safety envelope · panda MCU (E-03, E-04a) · F-08
The envelope bounds the size of a
A wrong curvature or a missed lead inside the
limits passes every check; only the driver or a
monitor on the SoC catches it.
relay; frames to the EPS and PCM
supervises; brakes, cancels, steers, takes over
the car's motion, seen by the driver and the cameras
AI error type that enters there (WP-C-11 §5)
Arrows between processes are cereal services (§9); dashed arrows are not data the item acts on.
Generated by fig_s03_functional_flow.py; every process, service, function and error type is checked against WP-S-03 §8–§9, WP-C-01 §2.1 and WP-C-11 §5.

g.text: Terms: AE-nn AI error type (WP-C-11 §5) · AI artificial intelligence · AI-nn AI component (WP-C-11 §2.1): AI-1 driving model, AI-2 big driving model (excluded), AI-3 driver monitoring model · ASIL Automotive Safety Integrity Level, A (lowest)

to D (highest), from ISO 26262 · CAN controller area network: the vehicle's data bus · E-nn element of the item (WP-C-01 §3.1), E-01…E-06 · EPS electric power steering · F-nn function of the item (WP-C-01 §2.1), F-01…F-09 · MCU microcontroller:

the panda safety processor (STM32H7) · PCM powertrain control module (engine and drive) · QM quality managed: no ASIL; ordinary quality processes suffice · RX receive · SoC system on chip: the comma device's main processor, running openpilot

(QM) · SPI serial peripheral interface (the link between SoC and MCU) · WP-nn work product, e.g. WP-C-04; the letter is its area (M management, C concept, S system, H hardware, W software, V validation, P processes, A analyses, O operation, K
